hypotheses.fit_reason: The security-sensitive decision is based on input validation (typeof info.name === 'string' && typeof info.bin === 'string') without sufficient checks on the content of info.bin, which could be malicious.

The condition 'typeof info.name === 'string' && typeof info.bin === 'string' && info.bin.length > 0' will always evaluate to true for a non-empty string, making the length check redundant and potentially misleading.
The code does not validate or sanitize the content of info.bin, which could contain malicious data that leads to security vulnerabilities when processed further.
